title: File:Cataratas Victoria, Zambia-Zimbabue, 2018-07-27, DD 16-20 PAN.jpg
author: Diego Delso
description: Aerial panoramic view of the Victoria Falls of the Zambezi River, border between Zambia and Zimbabwe. The Victoria Falls is the largest sheet of falling water in the world based on its combined width of 1,708 metres (5,604 ft) and height of 108 metres (354 ft). This picture is the result of stitching 5 frames taken from a helicopter.
